# **CompanyHierarchy Container**

## **Overview**

Part of [storefront-company-management](https://github.com/adobe-commerce/storefront-company-management) dropin.

The **CompanyHierarchy** container is used to display and manage the company organizational hierarchy with full administrative capabilities. It serves as the primary interface for company administrators to visualize parent-child relationships and reorganize company structures through an interactive tree view with drag-and-drop support.

⚠️Important: Company Hierarchy supports only a single-level structure (parent-child relationship). Child companies cannot have their own child companies, and nested hierarchies are not supported.

![][image1]

**Operational Modes**

The container operates in multiple view modes based on data state and user permissions:

* **IS\_LOADING**: Displays loading spinner during initial admin status check and data fetch  
* **NO\_ACCESS**: Shows access denied message when user lacks company administrator privileges  
* **IS\_EMPTY**: Displays empty state when no companies exist in the hierarchy  
* **IS\_ERROR**: Shows error message when API calls fail or network errors occur  
* **SHOW\_STRUCTURE**: Renders the full interactive hierarchy tree with all functionality

**Data Retrieval**

The container automatically orchestrates data fetching through the following GraphQL operations:

* **Admin Check**: \`isCompanyAdmin\` query from the \`customer GraphQL query\` validates if the authenticated user has Company Administrator role (role.id \=== '0' or role.name \=== 'Company Administrator')  
* **Hierarchy Data**: \`getCompanyHierarchy\` query fetches the complete company structure including parent-child relationships via the \`customer.company\_hierarchy\` field  
* **Structure Modifications**:  
  * \`assignChildCompany\` mutation assigns a child company to a parent company  
  * \`unassignChildCompany\` mutation removes a child company from its parent, making it root-level

**Displayed Information:**

* Company names displayed in hierarchical tree structure  
* Visual distinction between root companies (no parent) and child companies (nested under parent)  
* Optional admin badges showing "Admin" tag for companies where is\_admin: true  
* Drag handles for child companies enabling structure reorganization  
* Expand/Collapse indicators for companies with children  
* Company icons differentiating root-level (opacity 100%) from child-level companies  
* Selection highlighting with blue border on clicked companies  
* Toolbar with "Expand All" and "Collapse All" action buttons

**Available Actions:**

* **Expand/Collapse Nodes**: Click chevron icons to show/hide child companies  
* **Expand All**: Button action to expand all tree nodes simultaneously  
* **Collapse All**: Button action to collapse all nodes (except virtual root)  
* **Select Company**: Click any company row to highlight and select it  
* **Drag Company**: Drag child companies to reorganize hierarchy structure  
* **Drop Company**: Drop companies on root-level companies or virtual root to reassign relationships  
* **Auto-Refresh**: Automatic data reload after successful assign/unassign operations

**ACL Permissions:**

The container requires the following access control permissions for full functionality:

* **Company Administrator Role**: User must have Company Administrator role (validated via isCompanyAdmin() API)

**Note**: The container automatically handles permission validation. Non-admin users see the NO\_ACCESS view mode instead of hierarchy data.

## **Container Integration Example**

| import { CompanyHierarchy } from '@dropins/storefront-company-management/containers/CompanyHierarchy.js';import { render as provider } from '@dropins/storefront-company-management/render.js';import { Button } from '@adobe-commerce/elsie/components';*// Basic Usage Without Header*provider.render(CompanyHierarchy, {   *// No props needed for basic use*})(element);*// With Header Title*provider.render(CompanyHierarchy, {   withHeader: true,})(element);*// Collapsed by Default with Admin Badges*provider.render(CompanyHierarchy, {   defaultExpanded: false,   showAdminBadge: true,   withHeader: true,})(element);*// With Custom Styling and Actions Slot*provider.render(CompanyHierarchy, {   className: 'custom-hierarchy-styling',   withHeader: true,   defaultExpanded: true,   showAdminBadge: true,   slots: {      Actions: ({ expandAll, collapseAll, treeItemsCount }) \=\> (         \<div className\="custom-actions"\>            \<Button onClick\={expandAll}\>Open All ({treeItemsCount})\</Button\>            \<Button onClick\={collapseAll}\>Close All\</Button\>            \<Button\>Export Structure\</Button\>         \</div\>      )   }})(element); |
| :---- |

## **Container Configurations**

**withHeader**

* **Type**: \`boolean\` \[optional\]  
* **Description**: Controls whether to display the header title "Company Hierarchy" above the tree view. When enabled, a styled header with divider is rendered using the Elsie Header component.  
* **Usage Scenarios:**  
  * Set to \`true\` when displaying hierarchy as a standalone page section requiring a title  
  * Set to \`false\` (default) when embedding hierarchy within another container that already has a title  
  * Use \`true\` for full-page views in company management dashboards  
  * Use \`false\` for sidebar widgets or embedded views in multi-section pages

**className**

* **Type**: \`string\` \[optional\]  
* **Description**: Custom CSS class name applied to the root container element for additional styling or theme integration. Merged with the default \`account-company-hierarchy\` class.  
* **Usage Scenarios:**  
  * Apply custom brand styling to match existing design systems  
  * Add responsive layout classes for mobile/tablet optimization  
  * Integrate with utility CSS frameworks (Tailwind, Bootstrap, etc.)  
  * Override default spacing, colors, or typography for specific implementations

**defaultExpanded**

* **Type**: \`boolean\` \[optional\]  
* **Description**: Controls the initial expansion state of all tree nodes. If true, all nodes are expanded on mount. If false, all nodes are collapsed except the virtual root. Default value is true.  
* **Usage Scenarios:**  
  * Set to \`true\` for small hierarchies (\< 10 companies) where users need immediate visibility  
  * Set to \`false\` for large hierarchies (20+ companies) to prevent visual overload  
  * Use \`true\` when users typically need to see the complete structure immediately  
  * Use \`false\` for progressive disclosure in compact layouts or mobile views

**showAdminBadge**

* **Type**: \`boolean\` \[optional\]  
* **Description**: Controls whether to display "Admin" tag badges next to companies where the user has administrative privileges (is\_admin: true). When enabled, a Tag component with "Admin" label appears inline with the company name. Default value is false.  
* **Usage Scenarios:**  
  * Set to \`true\` in multi-company environments where users manage multiple organizations  
  * Enable when users need quick visual identification of administrative access rights  
  * Use in company selection interfaces where permissions context is critical  
  * Disable for single-company users or when permissions are irrelevant to the task

**slots**

* **Type**: \`{ Actions?: SlotProps\<HierarchyActionsContext\> }\` \[optional\]  
* **Description**: Customizable slot for replacing or extending the default toolbar actions. Receives context with expandAll, collapseAll, expandedIds, setExpandedIds, and treeItemsCount for building custom controls.  
* **Usage Scenarios:**  
  * Replace default "Expand All" / "Collapse All" buttons with custom-styled controls  
  * Add additional toolbar actions like "Export to PDF", "Print Structure", or "Share Hierarchy"  
  * Implement custom filtering or search functionality above the tree  
  * Display company count badges or hierarchy statistics in the toolbar  
  * Integrate with analytics tracking for expand/collapse events

**HierarchyActionsContext Properties:**

* expandAll: \`() \=\> void\` — Function to expand all tree nodes  
* collapseAll: \`() \=\> void\` — Function to collapse all nodes (except virtual root)  
* expandedIds: \`Set\<string\>\` — Current set of expanded node IDs  
* setExpandedIds: \`(ids: Set\<string\>) \=\> void\` — Function to programmatically control expansion state  
* treeItemsCount: \`number\` — Total number of companies in the hierarchy

## **Admin Panel Configurations**

There are no direct admin panel configurations that affect the **CompanyHierarchy** container's rendering behavior or data display. However, the feature requires the following foundational configurations to function properly:

### **Store-Level Configuration**

**Path**: \`Stores \> Settings \> Configuration \> General \> B2B Features \> Company\`

* **Enable Company Registration from the Storefront**: Must be set to "Yes" to allow company creation  
* **Enable Company**: Must be set to "Yes" to enable all company-related features including hierarchy management

### **Company-Level Configuration**

**Path**: \`Customers \> Companies \> Edit Company \> Advanced Settings\`

* The parent company must exist and be in "Active" status  
* Child companies must have valid company records before they can be assigned to parent companies

### **Permission Requirements**

No dedicated ACL resources control access, Company Hierarchy feature available only for the Company Administrator. The container automatically validates that the authenticated user has Company Administrator privileges via the isCompanyAdmin() API before displaying hierarchy data. Non-admin users will see a "No Access" message regardless of admin panel settings.
